status: Accepted direction and documented acceptance targets; software implementation pending
definition: Reusable open-source operations layer for connecting ventilation and air-management equipment and tracing observations, diagnosis, authorized actions, result verification and maintenance across facilities and vendors.

user_confirmed.target_scope: Food production and other ventilation-required facilities
user_confirmed.primary_user: Nontechnical facility managers must be able to use agent-guided installation and configuration
user_confirmed.implementation_delegation: Main agent may use subagents as needed to improve accepted findings
user_confirmed.physical_devices: Simulated physical devices authorized by organizer according to user

consistent_management: Shared contracts, permissions, workflows and evidence; facility-specific targets and controls.

core: observations with units, provenance and observed/received timestamps
command ID, expiry, idempotency, ACK and measured-result checks
user_surfaces: Codex plugin with onboarding and operation workflows
MCP tools for the shared service
deployment_profiles: two facility MN-CSEs and a central IN-CSE demonstration

defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.real_devices: Observe and diagnose until configuration explicitly enables scoped controls
defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.simulated_demo: Preauthorized bounded automatic actions may run without a human performing model steps
defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.profile_authority: Facility administrator activates profiles; AI can prepare and explain drafts but cannot grant itself authority
defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.core_demo: Local, no hardware or paid API credentials required; dependency download/network prerequisites documented
defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.llm_provider: Configurable provider/model endpoint; do not assume the internal reviewer model name is available through a public API
defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.secrets: Local secret/environment injection; no keys in source, ordinary tool results or model prompts
defaults_not_explicit_user_actuation_cho.language: English submission/developer reference; Korean operator onboarding for the initial user

tool_contract_candidate.name: doctor
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Check declared dependencies, connection and runtime state without exposing credentials

tool_contract_candidate.name: prepare_setup
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Validate a facility profile and provide an intelligible setup plan

tool_contract_candidate.name: apply_setup
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Apply authorized idempotent configuration; report separate runtime/CSE/MCP readiness

tool_contract_candidate.name: discover
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Find accessible facilities and equipment using oneM2M discovery

tool_contract_candidate.name: read_group
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Query a real CSE group/fopt and retain per-member responses

tool_contract_candidate.name: read_evidence
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Retrieve current observations, freshness, device state and incident history

tool_contract_candidate.name: request_action
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Create authorized scoped control or maintenance requests after server-side validation

tool_contract_candidate.name: verify_result
tool_contract_candidate.purpose: Check CSE state, device ACK and subsequent observations; distinguish incomplete outcomes

llm_execution.shared_path: Codex or standalone real-model runner -> same MCP tool contract -> openSoom service -> actual CSE
llm_execution.persistent_state: Service-owned run and incident records, not only conversation history
llm_execution.trace: runId -> model-generated tool call -> oneM2M requestId -> incident/command/ACK/observations
llm_execution.pass_rule: A live pass requires actual model-generated tool calls and checked service outcomes. Fixture fallback cannot be reported as a live-model success.

acceptance_targets_not_official_rubric: Fresh supported Codex environment completes guided setup without editing application source.
Plugin installation, MCP connection, runtime startup and actual CSE operation are checked separately.
Account-free deterministic demo reproduces normal operation, exhaust anomaly, missing observation, maintenance action and recovery evidence.
A real LLM API runner completes the same service flow, with tool traces and final CSE outcome verification.
At least two facility profiles use the same core code; first candidates are a cooking/food-production area and a meeting/classroom ventilation example.
At least two vendor adapters with different field/unit formats use the same application/tool code.
Role/ACP denials, stale data, wrong tool arguments, duplicate requests and bounded error recovery have meaningful checks.
README, diagnostics, stop/restart and cleanup instructions are verified independently.
Simulated physical data, actual CSE/MCP/model execution and unsupported real equipment are labeled honestly.

advanced_features.handover: Conditional on a real availability/maintenance need and explicit transition evidence
advanced_features.mec_deployment: Feasibility check accepted; platform access and actual deployment evidence required
advanced_features.mec_services: MEC033 onboarding/discovery is a candidate if an endpoint is actually available
advanced_features.federated_learning: Deferred until data-locality and multi-facility learning need plus ESTIMED VM path exist
advanced_features.geolocation: Deferred until location changes operational behavior; static addresses do not establish service integration

publication.third_party: Retain third-party licenses and attribution; do not relicense third-party assets by assumption
publication.external_actions: Prepare artifacts; public posting/submission and messages remain separately authorized actions
